correctness.rationale: Each k-step hypercube geodesic changes k distinct coordinates once; cube translations and permutations reduce it to a canonical initial-ones prefix chain with d-k untouched coordinates, yielding a factor (1+z)^(d-k). For a k-bit word with t ones and prefix ones u_j, distance to chain equals t-max_j(2u_j-j). Reflection principle for up/down walks gives a fixed-t shell count C(k,r)-C(k,r-1) for r<=t<=k-r, hence factor (k-2r+1). Leading coefficient positive through floor(k/2), so eccentricity d-ceil(k/2). For each pair of endpoints at Hamming distance k there are k! shortest paths, giving exactly 2^(d-1)d! (odd) or 2^d d! (even) minimizing unoriented paths; k=0/d=1 edges handled. Independent direct Hamming enumeration verified every (d,k) with 1<=d<=9 and 0<=k<=d, 54 complete shell comparisons.
